summary: Adapts an independently versioned Pi Agent through Muxiva's recoverable Turn Controller and capability-routing contract.

connection.description: Create both values in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio China (Beijing), in the same workspace.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API Key
fields.help: Create a pay-as-you-go Model Studio API Key in China (Beijing) and copy it when shown.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.label: Workspace ID
fields.help: Open the top-right workspace menu and copy the ID for the same workspace and region as the API Key.

api_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible model endpoint. May also be supplied through DASHSCOPE_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL.

system_prompt.default: You are a capable Muxiva coding agent. Inspect the workspace before making claims. Use file tools to read, search, create, and edit real project files. Use web_search for current or external facts and cite its source URLs in your answer. This is a voice-first conversation with a rich chat transcript: answer in short, natural spoken sentences; complete requested file work before replying; summarize created code, tables, and links instead of dumping them into the answer; avoid Markdown emphasis around ordinary words; and never read long code or URLs aloud. Never claim access outside the configured workspace.

workspace_root.description: Workspace path relative to the Graph project root; absolute paths and escapes are rejected.

workspace_tools_enabled.description: Declare and expose workspace coding capabilities. Disabled capabilities cannot be granted by any route.

information_tools_enabled.description: Expose date/time and current/forecast weather tools.

default_weather_city.description: City used when a weather request omits its location. Empty requires the Agent to provide a city.

default_time_zone.description: IANA time zone used when a time request omits one.

device_tools_enabled.description: Expose physical device-control tools such as speaker volume.

device_hub_url.description: Device command endpoint. Prefer the ESP32_HUB_URL environment variable for deployments.

artwork_tools_enabled.description: Expose image generation, persistent artwork, replay, and gallery tools.

artwork_public_base_url.description: Public base URL for generated artwork. Prefer MUXIVA_IMAGE_PUBLIC_URL for deployments.

artwork_style_prompt.description: Optional medium and display constraints prepended to image-generation requests while preserving the original user prompt in the gallery.

image_generation_endpoint.description: Image generation endpoint. May also be supplied through DASHSCOPE_IMAGE_ENDPOINT.

image_prepare_script.description: Optional image preparation script; empty uses the project default.

gallery_builder_script.description: Optional gallery builder script; empty uses the project default.

web_search_enabled.description: Expose the explicit Bailian web_search Tool.

web_search_endpoint.description: Bailian search endpoint. May also be supplied through DASHSCOPE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT.

web_search_model.description: Bailian model used for live search synthesis.

sentence_chunk_min_characters.description: Coalesce tiny opening fragments before speech output so names and decimal values are not split across TTS requests.

max_history_messages.description: Maximum model conversation messages retained by the Agent.

strip_stage_directions.description: Remove model-generated stage directions before voice output.

emotion_events_enabled.description: Emit transport-neutral emotion.changed events inferred from spoken text.

agent_first_output_timeout_ms.description: Fail and rotate a Driver that emits no text or lifecycle event before this deadline.

agent_turn_timeout_ms.description: Hard deadline for one Agent Turn.

timeout_message.default: 这次响应超时了，我已经自动恢复，请再说一次。

failure_message.default: 这次响应失败了，我已经自动恢复，请再说一次。

progress_message.description: Optional application-owned progress message. Empty disables spoken progress.

progress_delay_ms.description: Delay before the optional progress message; zero disables it.

previous_only_cancel_signals.description: Canonical and compatibility Signals that cancel only older-sequence Turns, so a same-sequence admitted Prompt survives its cancellation watermark.
